description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-23. -->
## YouTube fixes

- **Shorts downloads:** On supported YouTube 21.x versions, tapping **Download** on the first Short opens quality choices for the video on screen. No swipe away and back is needed. The 20.05.46 download path is unchanged. ([#74](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/74))
- **Player buttons:** Play/Pause/Replay icons now render at their final size instead of stretching a smaller bitmap when enlarged. The background-opacity sliders and touch targets are unchanged. ([#72](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/72))

On a Moto Edge Plus 2023 running YouTube 21.45.90, the first Download tap showed the matching title and real quality choices on three different Shorts. Play and Pause were verified at 120% in portrait. All four supported YouTube versions patched without force or missing extension references.

Update the RVX patch source in Manager, then repatch YouTube and install the resulting app.
